front_registration.method: Direct source-photo sampling using existing stage31 back registration; illumination normalization only
limitations: Existing registration is approximate on stretched fabric, not metrologically 1:1.

method: Whole photograph registration with two-view curved heel chart and local same-knit donor repairs for the removed foot symbol.
